note: A two-day workshop on a shared Health DPI architecture, 17-18 September 2026; it names no exchange in service, contracted, built or piloted.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health and Sanitation reports it launched a Health Information Hub, described as fully functional, that integrates data from multiple platforms including DHIS2 and consolidates facility, human resources, supply chain and referral data.

note: The roadmap states that 81.2% of digital health solutions neither connect with DHIS2 nor integrate with others and 10% are HL7-FHIR compatible, and plans standards, a national EHR and a unique health ID review; it names no exchange contracted, built or in service, so no fact.

facts.fact: Atlantic Infos reports that WAHO opened a five-day regional workshop in Cotonou to pilot automated transfer of routine health data from national DHIS2 systems, with Sierra Leone one of four pilot countries.
facts.system: WAHO automated routine health data sharing (DHIS2)

systems.system: WAHO automated routine health data sharing (DHIS2)
